subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up / token volumes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up / token volumes

Alex — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we can align on pricing/bracket options: 

Summary from call:
- Use cases: in-product assistant (chat) + knowledge search + relevance tuning (rerank) for critical workflows.
- Expected traffic: conversational turns (chat) ~ 18M tokens/month initially, embeddings for search ~ 6M vectors/month (~3M embedding requests), rerank ~ 2M requests (short context).
- Model requirements: preference for a mix of high-quality chat model for core UX, cheaper embeddings model for search, and a small reranker optimized for throughput.
- Security: BrightLayer will need SOC2 evidence and VPC/private option for production.

Pricing/Unit economics discussion items:
- Target cost target Alex mentioned: ~$800-1,200 / 1M tokens as an initial blended threshold for chat-heavy flows (target cost to keep economics aligned with their pricing).
- Need to understand per-model split so we can produce per-mode unit cost and a blended $/1M tokens.

Attachments: I attached the sample prompts + the volumes spreadsheet you mentioned. Please confirm numbers in the sheet if anything above is off.

Next steps:
1) Alex: confirm the per-month volumes in the attached spreadsheet (columns: chat_turn_tokens, embeddings_count, rerank_requests).
2) Rishi / I will prepare 2 pricing scenarios: conservative (higher performance model mix) and optimized (quantized/cheaper model variants + batching) with blended $/1M tokens and expected monthly cost.
3) If the numbers look right, propose a 60-day pilot with Dedicated capacity (reserved baseline + burst) — we can include SLA language for latency on the chat endpoint.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: BrightLayer_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet), BrightLayer_sample_prompts.txt (text)

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up / token volumes

Thanks Marissa — that looks right. A couple clarifications after talking internally: 

- Chat volumes: the 18M tokens is per-month aggregated across our web and mobile assistant. Expect ~70% of that to be short-turn interactions (<= 120 tokens) and ~30% long-form (>= 400 tokens) for deep-help sessions.
- Embeddings: 3M active users, we do a 1:1 mapping for search updates so 3M vectors/month initially; we included some buffer to 6M in the sheet for re-index cadence.
- Rerank: 2M requests/month but each request will hit a small 128-token context.
- Budget range: we have a procurement ceiling of roughly $60k/month for inference for year one, but we'd prefer to come in under $45k if quality isn't compromised.

Are you able to provide an initial blended $/1M tokens estimate for the two scenarios you outlined? Procurement also asked for an estimate on Dedicated reserved baseline size (GPUs) for the pilot.

I'll update the spreadsheet with the 70/30 short/long split for chat and re-upload.

Regards,
Alex
Alex Jones
Head of Product — BrightLayer
alex.jones@brightlayer.com

Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up / token volumes

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications and the 70/30 split. Rishi and I discussed and we should be able to produce the two scenarios by end of day today. Preliminary high-level guidance so you have context before the deck: 

Scenario A — Conservative (higher quality)
- Chat: gptx-chat-large (quantization TBD) — estimated blended chat cost ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens given long-form distribution
- Embeddings: embed-medium — ~$35 / 1M tokens equivalent (per-vector unit economics converted)
- Rerank: cheap cross-encoder optimized for throughput — ~$20 / 1M tokens equivalent
- Blended estimate: ~ $1,050 / 1M tokens (weighted by token volumes as-provided) — estimated monthly cost: ~$63k (above their $60k ceiling).

Scenario B — Optimized (cost-focused)
- Chat: gptx-chat-medium (8-bit quantized, aggressive batching) — estimated chat cost ~ $700 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: embed-small (approx) — ~$20 / 1M token-equivalent
- Rerank: distilled reranker — ~$12 / 1M token-equivalent
- Blended estimate: ~ $650 / 1M tokens — estimated monthly cost: ~$39k (within their preferred $45k).

We'll include assumptions (batching, KV cache hit rates, percent of tokens charged for embeddings conversions) and expected latency SLOs per scenario.

Next steps:
- Rishi: can you draft recommended Dedicated baseline GPU count for the pilot (target latency p95 for chat < 400ms) and include cost/commit sizing?
- Alex: once you update the sheet with the 70/30 split we will finalize the numbers and send a short two-page pricing summary + proposal.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
